```yaml
name: Godot Addon Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux
          - os: macos-latest
            platform: macos
          - os: windows-latest
            platform: windows

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive

    - name: Setup MSVC (Windows)
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
      uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@v1
      with:
        arch: x64

    - name: Setup CMake
      uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
      with:
        cmakeListsTxtPath: CMakeLists.txt
        buildDirectory: build
        cmakeBuildType: Release
        cmakeGenerator: "Unix Makefiles"

    - name: Build on Linux/macOS
      if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'
      run: |
        cd build
        cmake ..
        make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Build on Windows
      if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
      run: |
        cd build
        cmake .. -G "Visual Studio 16 2019" -A x64
        cmake --build . --config Release

    - name: Create addon structure
      run: |
        mkdir -p addon/${{ matrix.platform }}
        cp build/libamy.so addon/${{ matrix.platform }}/libamy.so
        cp build/libamy.dll addon/${{ matrix.platform }}/libamy.dll
        cp -r src/* addon/
        cp -r godot/* addon/

    - name: Create addon zip
      run: |
        cd addon
        zip -r ../amy-addon.zip .

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: amy-addon-${{ matrix.platform }}
        path: amy-addon.zip
```
